what_happened.line: The Personnel Committee approved, by voice vote, the hire of an interim principal assessor at a rate above the start of the pay range.
The rate was set above the range start because of the new hire's long assessing experience; members said it should not disturb other employees' pay.
The hire is a retiree under the regional retirement system, whose annual hours are limited, so she could not fill the full 40-hour permanent role.
The committee set its next meeting for January 5th at the library.

why_it_matters: The town's assessing office is staffed on an interim basis by a part-time retiree, and the permanent full-time role is still to be filled, which bears on how property valuations that feed tax bills get done.
watch_next: Personnel Committee meeting on January 5th at the library.
